workflows.name: Push Parametric Data to Airtable
workflows.user_goal: Take a tree/list of tabular data computed in Grasshopper (a panel schedule, a room list, a cost breakdown) and create it as rows in an Airtable table in one shot, instead of hand-typing or copy/pasting into a spreadsheet.
workflows.data_shape: tree of records (one branch per row) -> list of Record JSON -> batch create_records (10/call)

workflows.name: Drive Generation from Airtable Data
workflows.user_goal: Pull records from a table (a room program, a component library, a task list) into Grasshopper as a tree, and vary geometry/logic per item using each record's fields — tedious row-by-row in Airtable's own grid, trivial as a tree operation in GH.
workflows.data_shape: list_records -> list of records -> tree of field values, one branch per record

workflows.name: Compute-and-Write-Back Analysis Results
workflows.user_goal: For each record, run a computation Airtable's formula fields can't express (structural check, daylight score, geometry-derived metric), then write the result back into the matching record by Record ID — a round-trip analysis loop.
workflows.data_shape: list_records -> tree of records -> per-branch computed value paired with Record ID -> batch update_records

workflows.name: Sync Generative Model to Airtable by Key (Upsert)
workflows.user_goal: Keep a table in lock-step with a live parametric model — re-running the definition updates existing rows and inserts new ones, matched by an external key field, without manually tracking record IDs or creating duplicates.
workflows.data_shape: tree of records with a key field -> batch update_records with performUpsert.fieldsToMergeOn

workflows.name: Discover Base & Table Schema
workflows.user_goal: Browse which bases/tables/fields the token can see, directly on the canvas, so the right table/field names can be wired without alt-tabbing to the Airtable web UI to copy IDs.
workflows.data_shape: item lookups -> lists of base/table/field names and ids

workflows.name: Attach Pictures to Records
workflows.user_goal: Attach an image to a record from a file path, a URL, or a live Grasshopper/Rhino bitmap — same payload contract regardless of source.
workflows.data_shape: unit (file path | url | bitmap) -> Attachment JSON -> create_records/update_records (url case) or uploadAttachment (file/bitmap case, base64)

workflows.name: Build Color-Coded Select Fields
workflows.user_goal: Generatively define a Single/Multi-Select field's choices, each assigned one of Airtable's 40 fixed color names — e.g. auto-categorize a computed classification into colored tags.
workflows.data_shape: tree of choice labels -> parallel tree/preset of color names -> Field JSON -> create_field/update_field

workflows.name: Create Table Layouts
workflows.user_goal: Generatively scaffold a whole new table — name plus full column/field list — from a Grasshopper-defined schema, in one call.
workflows.data_shape: list of field definitions -> Table JSON -> create_table
